decisions.rationale: The decimal-rounding gap classification is substantive and unresolved: choosing an uncertainty and representing a measured decimal to its justified place requires elementary decimal-place rounding, absent from the complete current Mathematics definitions checked in the earlier independent review. Natural-number rounding, decimal representation and scientific-notation interpretation do not certify it. The separately proposed P amendment legitimately supplies representative estimates and spread information while retaining independent uncertainty choice, resolution-versus-spread transfer, consistent notation and systematics limits. It removes a gratuitous statistics algorithm but does not close the rounding gap or approve a new Math goal/edge.

decisions.rationale: The expanded prerequisites now cover term values and simple multiplicative inverse parameters and are closer to the current P body. They still do not substantiate its obligatory independent transformation of T=2π√(l/g) into T²=(4π²/g)l: reading/evaluating a term and solving a·x=b, x:a=b or a:x=b does not certify squaring a compound radical equation. In addition, f4df dimensions has no BY applicability while this Physics goal does; explicit prerequisite lookup/remediation in BY must be evidenced rather than inferred from its Q4 phase. Current profile variation also includes inverse/exponential alternatives, which must remain alternatives rather than an AND of all methods. No approval for the five-edge exact packet yet.
